turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: As an enterprise customer, what's been most important to you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: SOC 2 compliance and a signed DPA were non-negotiable for our legal team. 12Labs had both ready to go, which actually sped up our procurement compared to two competitors we evaluated.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Anything on the enterprise side that's been a gap?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: SSO/SAML took an extra round of back-and-forth with your team to configure correctly — the self-serve docs for SSO setup are thinner than the rest of the docs.
